provider: RIPE Atlas (host a probe or anchor)

free_tier.stated: no storage; hosting earns credits spendable on custom measurements

interface_detail: probe hardware or software probe; REST API for measurements
limits_note: Hosting a probe earns credits, and credits buy measurements - not bytes and not disk. A software probe can run on your own infrastructure, which makes it the most accessible thing in this whole slot (no shipping, no institution), but it is a measurement vantage point with trivial bandwidth and no storage. Anchors are bigger and require a datacentre-grade commitment plus approval.
reliability_note: Hardware probes are frequently out of stock; software probes have negligible throughput by design.

evidence.proved: 'You can either apply to host a hardware probe, which we will ship to you ... or a software probe, which you can install and run on your own infrastructure'; 'You'll earn credits you can use for your own customised measurements'
'They are not always in stock, you may have to apply and wait for one'; 'Apply for a software probe through your account'
'The vast majority of data that RIPE Atlas collects is freely available to anyone to browse, download or use'
